content: The VAT1 synaptic vesicle membrane protein, also known as VAT-1 homolog, is a protein encoded by the VAT1 gene in humans. Synaptic vesicles play a critical role in the regulation of neurotransmitter storage and release at the nerve terminal. The protein encoded by the VAT1 gene is an abundant integral membrane protein found in cholinergic synaptic vesicles and is believed to participate in vesicular transport processes. This protein is classified as a member of the quinone oxidoreductase subfamily within the zinc-containing alcohol dehydrogenase protein family. In melanocytic cells, the expression of the VAT1 gene may be regulated by the microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF).
